cards.title: Extra capacity settings
intro: Current number of extra places available for this class: 1

fields.label: Extra capacity
fields.help: If the number of registrants reaches the maximum capacity for the class, it is possible to increase this capacity. These extra places are shared: they are used for make-up sessions, and for trials when the programme places trial attendees in extra capacity.

fields.label: How this number is applied
options: Add it to the number from general settings (currently: 1)
Use it instead of the number from general settings
